choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: I cannot help being more frightened at the idea of the malediction of the dead than the hatred of the living.
Do you, then, know in what manner Fernand injured Dantès?
However, when Morrel went down to his dinner, he appeared very calm.

title: Penelon — the Dantès affair, years on
